scope: Read-only RC50 reconciliation of local historical and current opportunity records. It is neither universal opportunity exhaustion nor RC50 acceptance.

rc50.requirement: Reconcile every historical queued method by distinct mechanism and actual source/evidence, including the original Squash-codec inventory.
rc50.reason: Finite research disposition is complete, but current-source mapping and acceptance evidence remain open.

groups.finding: The hindsight oracle is explicitly non-causal and cannot be an archive-saving target. RELEASE-PREDICTIVE-1 is the decisive frozen causal record: over 49,152 held-out bytes, recurrence-v3 N1/N2 are worse than fixedmix-v1 by 0.006298/0.006361 b/B and the causal gain is 0.000256 b/B, below the >0.05 b/B and >1% gate. Its PPM raw path is a separate diagnostic and its paid valid mass is 0.000000, so it remains a coding-path-only interface rather than a pool forecast. The trace source and predictive script still match their freeze hashes (361a4a5a4c2f31398754703393dc384be891d80494ab828dd383fb8d38ce4eb6 and 1e2eac7b667c774f59d58cde750ecd38cad2c9f9470c92c16fa3ebf71880208a); each copied native implementation identity in that freeze differs from the current file identity. That later source difference does not reopen either non-promotion decision.
groups.bounded_action: Do not reopen the mixture, recurrence-v3, or PPM research route. Keep the historical result and its frozen identities attached to their scope. Only if final release acceptance needs a native feature inventory, map the then-frozen native selector and PPM interface to this already-final classification; that mapping is release evidence, not a request for a new trace or experiment.
groups.proof_needed: No further predictive proof for RC50 research disposition. A final native mapping is needed only if a release claim includes these routes: identify the final source selection/interface and the associated normal native correctness receipt, while retaining RELEASE-PREDICTIVE-1 as the decision record.

groups.finding: Long-match residual prediction and calibration have declared finite designs, but no accepted current-RC complete-byte result. The finite closure defers them; it does not establish that autoregressive methods are exhausted.
groups.bounded_action: Keep deferred unless a new source-bound mechanism is proposed after RC. Do not treat the old planning rows as an implementation omission.
groups.proof_needed: None for the current release disposition. Any later promotion needs a fixed-window causal residual frame, paid model/configuration bytes, matched control and fresh archive-only decode.

groups.finding: A generated dictionary ties its matched direct-function control. A shared seeded nonlinear coordinate model wins only on constructed hidden-support data and loses on the five finite real samples. The older Wikipedia projection screens also record no verified gain in their stated scope.
groups.bounded_action: Do not expand seed counts, dimensions, function grammars or projection searches for this RC. Preserve the conditional result as research, not a proof against all generators or manifolds.
groups.proof_needed: No new RC proof. A later route needs an admitted real-data support relation, all seed/residual/framing costs, a deterministic decoder and a stronger complete-archive control.

groups.finding: The recorded center-out/adaptive-anchor/lane experiments did not pass their strongest controls; reversal's small historical saving is not a route promotion.
groups.bounded_action: Do not reopen the tested directional/lane variants. Existing direction-sensitive specialist behavior remains subject to native parity and normal correctness checks.
groups.proof_needed: For any different directional representation: exact reversible order metadata, complete-byte matched control, malformed handling and current-source decode evidence.

groups.finding: Paid structural descriptions, count/rank alternatives and numeric M6 composition lose or tie under their stated controls. Synthetic context and integer coding screens demonstrate mechanisms but do not create a general product gain.
groups.bounded_action: Keep C1-C3 and the tested numeric-composition branch closed. Retain useful existing numeric/grid/constraint specialists; do not reclassify them as rejected research.
groups.proof_needed: Current native specialist source-to-decoder parity and bounded malformed/resource checks. A new high-dimensional model would require a new paid direct-model hypothesis, not a relabelled closed count/rank mechanism.

groups.finding: BWT/local separation, range/count controls, raw DEFLATE, periodic candidates and varint/Rice alternatives are mapped as covered; new LZW, XPRESS, rANS and grammar frames are unproven new compatibility surfaces. Integer coding wins only on deliberately structured synthetic sequences and has no real-token integration result.
groups.bounded_action: Do not add an unmeasured grammar/coder merely to exhaust names. Preserve covered routes and make each retained route's native encode/decode/parity evidence explicit.
groups.proof_needed: Per retained route: source anchor, encoder/decoder format identity, malformed/trailing rejection, bounds, and current release-path round trip.

groups.finding: PAQ DEFLATE reconstruction is preserved as an existing capability, while Python/reference receipts are not native qualification. PAQ -12L remains an honest over-budget reference. Squash SDK availability is no longer absent: codec-hosts-v8 passed actual Squash0.8 plugin buffer, stream and custom-splice contracts after the preserved v3/v7 failures. That narrow receipt makes no CAN_FLUSH, host matrix, registry identifier, or release-package claim.
groups.bounded_action: Keep the resource exclusion and remaining external/product gates visible. Do not substitute a lower PAQ setting as equivalent or silently remove retained specialists. Treat the Squash contract as passed only for the pinned v8 host/source scope; retain final package, identifier, version/platform and any untested lifecycle claims as separate closure work.
groups.proof_needed: Native/library implementation and same-CIX worker parity for retained specialists. For Squash, only the final release mapping from the pinned v8 contract source/SDK to packaged host artifacts, accepted identifier and supported host/version scope remains; do not ask again whether an SDK contract exists.

groups.finding: The audit identifies conditional candidates such as libbsc/libcubwt, nvCOMP, ndzip and device-side component acceleration. No GPU workload, provider integration, throughput result or distribution qualification occurred. CPU-only default distribution remains the stated product baseline.
groups.bounded_action: No speculative GPU implementation is required for this RC. Keep the audit and conditional source/SDK/format/resource/fallback obligations in the RC50 record; do not claim acceleration is exhausted.
groups.proof_needed: For any shipped GPU route: actual provider source and licensing, hardware/API availability, CPU fallback or decoder, stable framing, transfer/VRAM/host-memory/cancellation bounds, CPU-only/GPU-present install tests, malformed payload evidence and reproducible dependency manifest.

rc50_gaps_for_coordinator: Attach each disposition to the current native source and release binary, not only historical Python/research identities.
Inventory every retained specialist and covered coder with current encoder, decoder, format, bound and malformed-input evidence; retain external SDK/identifier blockers separately.
Record the GPU audit as complete conditional investigation, with no provider qualification or acceleration claim.
non_claims: This map does not prove all compression opportunities have been explored.
Synthetic mechanism wins are not general-data or release-path gains.
No new experiment, benchmark, source change, dependency acquisition or coordinator-ledger update was performed.
